matchups.writeup: Aidan exploded for a league-best 144.46 pts behind 1.01 draft pick Jahmyr Gibbs (31.1), Caleb Williams (37.26), and D'Andre Swift (31.9) to claim the opening week scoring crown and the #1 seed. Andrew, the 3-time banner king OG, put up a stout 120.96 pts anchored by Lamar Jackson (24.96) and Javonte Williams (21.7), but suffered the week's toughest heartbreak as Ja'Marr Chase (1.3) was held to just 2.2 pts. Andrew's costly 72.1% coaching efficiency left 46.7 pts stranded on the bench (including Jalen Coker's 31.8 eruption), allowing Aidan to push his active streak over L Central to 3 straight games.

matchups.writeup: In the inaugural clash between the league's newest franchises, sophomore standout Brendan delivered 126.56 pts behind an electric 29.7-pt debut from rookie Ashton Jeanty (2.20) and a balanced assault from Chuba Hubbard (22.2) and Trey McBride (20.0). Brodie's expansion squad BloodSword2000 flashed scary high-end firepower behind Derrick Henry (2.17 / 34.8 pts) and Justin Jefferson (1.8 / 27.2 pts), but a 74.7% coaching efficiency left 35.1 pts on the bench (including Patrick Mahomes' 21.66 pts). Brendan rolls to 1-0 and locks down the #2 seed entering Week 2.

matchups.writeup: In a marquee battle of former champions, 2022 winner Austin rode Kenneth Walker III (2.18 / 32.6 pts), Chris Olave (25.2), and JSN (1.7 / 24.2 pts) to a comfortable 118.66-pt victory—even while absorbing a -4 from Houston's defense. Sean, a 2x champion OG and 2025 runner-up, laid a dud with a league-low 92.72 pts as De'Von Achane (1.11 / 8.6) and Drake London (2.14 / 4.5) were locked down. Austin jumps to #4 while Sean plummets to #12 in the cellar.

matchups.writeup: In the tightest battle of Week 1, Tyler spoiled the reigning champion's banner-raising week with a gritty 6.52-pt victory behind Amon-Ra St. Brown (1.9 / 23.7), Bucky Irving (16.8), and Chase Brown (2.16 / 16.3). Dylan, who rode a Cinderella run from the #5 seed to capture the 2025 title, was paced by Trevor Lawrence (26.1) and Zay Flowers (25.5), but paid dearly for benching Dalton Kincaid (17.5 pts) for Tucker Kraft (8.0 pts)—a +9.5 blunder that proved decisive in a 107.22 to 100.70 heartbreak.

Jonathan Taylor (27.2), DeVonta Smith (24.7), and Bryce Young (24.08) formed an unstoppable triple-threat. Michael, Pride Guys' most decorated titleless manager, falls to 0-2 despite CeeDee Lamb's 33.30-pt display as Trace cuts Michael's regular season series edge to 10-9.

James Cook III (20.4) and Dalton Kincaid (19.0) provided just enough cushion in a defensive grind. Brown failed to reach the end zone, dropping Phil to 0-2 while Dylan pushed his series streak over Phil to 3 straight.

Rookie owner Brodie Pirtle captured his first career Pride Guys franchise win in emphatic fashion, dropping 134.68 pts to upset 3-time banner king Andrew Wilson (91.90) by 42.78 pts. Davante Adams (37.5) and Derrick Henry (16.2) led BloodSword2000's onslaught. Andrew got 23.0 from Ja'Marr Chase, but the rest of L Central sputtered, sending the storied champion into an alarming 0-2 hole.

matchups.writeup: Tyler Hicks enters 2-0 with momentum surging after knocking off reigning champ Dylan and Nathan in consecutive weeks behind Amon-Ra St. Brown. Michael Anderson finds himself in unfamiliar territory, sitting at 0-2 for just the third time in his 10-year Pride Guys career (2017, 2022). Despite CeeDee Lamb's 33.30-pt Week 2 display, Michael holds a 2-1 series edge over Tyler (sweeping their 2023-2024 meetings) but urgently needs his running game to awaken to avoid just the second 0-3 start of his career.

matchups.writeup: A critical crossroad for two franchises looking to regain their footing. Nathan Wells (1-1) wasted a 40.82-pt masterclass from Josh Allen in Week 2 and looks to rebound alongside Bijan Robinson. Phillip Busick (0-2) is in urgent crisis mode after posting 55.98 pts in Week 2—the 9th lowest single-game score in the modern era (2022+). With A.J. Brown sidelined on IR, Phil desperately needs Puka Nacua and David Montgomery to carry the load to pull Joey Chestnuts out of the cellar. The regular season series is deadlocked at 2-2 with Phil having won their last meeting in Wk9'25.

matchups.writeup: Clash of Unbeatens! Two 2-0 contenders collide with an unblemished record on the line. Aidan O'Sullivan's attack is anchored by 1.01 draft pick Jahmyr Gibbs, but faces a test with QB Caleb Williams ruled out. Austin Geller counters with Kenneth Walker III and JSN, who has totaled 64.20 pts through two weeks—ranking 2nd in the entire league behind only Josh Allen (76.48 pts). Austin has historically controlled this matchup with a 7-3 regular season record (8-4 total), having swept Aidan in 2025. The winner jumps to 3-0 and secures inside positioning for the #1 overall seed.

matchups.writeup: Championship pedigree meets sophomore firepower. Andrew Wilson finds himself in an unfamiliar regular season jam, opening 0-2 in back-to-back years following an upset loss to rookie Brodie. Andrew has started 0-3 only once in his 10-year career (2022), having rebounded to win Week 3 in both 2020 and 2025. Brendan Sanders sits at 1-1 with Christian McCaffrey and Ashton Jeanty ready to rumble. The series is tied 1-1 after splitting blowouts in 2025. Andrew urgently needs Lamar Jackson and Ja'Marr Chase to deliver a signature performance to prevent an 0-3 hole.

matchups.writeup: A tale of two opposite trajectories. Two-time champion OG Sean Belcher sits in last place at 0-2 after averaging just 72.8 pts over the first two weeks—including a 52.96-pt disaster in Week 2 that is T-4th lowest in the modern era (2022+). He faces expansion rookie Brodie Pirtle, riding high after dropping 134.68 pts behind Davante Adams (3.32) and Derrick Henry (2.17) to earn his first franchise win over Andrew. Can the veteran OG summon championship pride, or will the newcomer bag another legend's scalp?
